reviewed_plan: Parent reviewed E01-E18 on 2026-10-17; opaque start-idempotency preservation is a direct advertised-field source correction.
typed_malformed_budget_boundary: Valid bool, arbitrary-width signed integer, Unicode/underscore integer string and finite float-to-int ordering are preserved. Malformed/nonfinite retained workflow budget values fail closed as invalid_input; original int(...) raises ValueError/TypeError. This is explicit typed malformed-record handling, not a claim of identical arbitrary Python exception bodies.
typed_provenance_guard: Original immutable-snapshot rehydration coerces engines collection members and primary engine to str; original serializer emits sorted nonempty names or [primary]. Therefore its defensive nonstring/empty-list record guard is unreachable on this actual source path, not merely in Rust typing. Native actual empty-primary and known/unknown-foreign controls preserve reachable error ordering.

candidate003_review_corrections.parent_scope: Inherited authority is checked only for nonempty evidence IDs. Bare parent references still require valid terminal association; new-query/research/tenant/cost fences remain. Replay after revocation/completion/deadline preserves all stored values and history.
candidate003_review_corrections.association_order: Terminal parent, admitted-ID subset, current parent dispatch policy using its original requires_intent_grant and captured evidence, then resolved/duplicate/variant/preview-budget checks. Later actual-evidence authority is revalidated at fenced admission.
candidate003_review_corrections.before_fix_result: The candidate003 implementation reproduced four failures; exact source identity and raw log retained in immutable qualification evidence. No original-runtime observations added.
